'''''Asteriscus sericeus''''', the '''Canary Island daisy''', is a species in the [[Asteraceae|daisy family]].<ref name=POWO/><ref name=WFO/><ref name="Compositae Working Group"/><ref name=GBIF>{{GBIF |id=5393680 |taxon=''Dorcatoma serra'' (Panzer, 1795) |access-date=23 January 2025}}</ref><ref>{{EOL |5047399 |''Asteriscus sericeus'' (L. fil.) DC. |access-date=23 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="Flora de Canarias"/> It is [[endemic]] to the [[Canary Islands]].<ref name=POWO/><ref name="Compositae Working Group"/><ref name="Flora de Canarias"/> Originally found only on [[Fuerteventura]], it has since been introduced to other islands in the archipelago.<ref name="Flora de Canarias"/>
